## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); major divergence among big-cap tech (MSFT, NVDA, META) supports a cautious posture and suppresses a strong regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads with clear winners: INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +21.62% | 1M: +45.10%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +28.59%) ABOVE TREND; Tech breadth: 15/24 positive (sector strength into early-cycle names). Energy showing strength: MPC (1W: +10.90% | 1M: +6.85%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.85% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY; Energy breadth: 7/10 positive. Materials are constructive after earnings: DD (news) with sector peers supporting momentum; Materials breadth: 7/11 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare is lagging: ABT (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -14.36%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -11.32%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare breadth: 5/17 positive (sector weakness). Financials are soft on 1W: JPM (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +4.67%) CORRECTION and PYPL (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +1.12%) CORRECTION; Financials breadth: 9/20 positive (internal rotation). Communication services remain weak: CHTR (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -27.64%) BELOW TREND; Comm breadth: 2/10 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +21.62% | 1M: +45.10%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +13.02% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +10.90% | 1M: +6.85%) ABOVE TREND; GD (1W: +10.65% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — tech and cyclicals both contributing.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -10.81% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND; META (1W: -10.41% | 1M: +4.97%) CORRECTION; SYK (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -11.32%) BELOW TREND; CHTR (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -27.64%) BELOW TREND; FDX (1W: -7.79% | 1M: +0.27%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in select tech and communication names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +28.72%), QCOM (1W: +21.62%), ORCL (1W: +10.51%). Major divergence flag: MSFT (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +9.83%) CORRECTION and NVDA (1W: -7.33% | 1M: +11.20%) CORRECTION — tactical risk as short-term selling conflicts with month trend.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive; several names ABOVE TREND (INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +21.62% | 1M: +45.10%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +28.59%) ABOVE TREND) while mega-cap FAANGs show short-term corrections (MSFT CORRECTION, NVDA CORRECTION, META CORRECTION). Sector breadth: 15/24 positive — internal rotation between high-multiple and recovery names.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious rotation inside the group; JPM (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +4.67%) CORRECTION, V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +5.86%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +1.12%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: 9/20 positive — style mixed, not a clear rally.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Lagging with pockets of strength: LLY (1W: +13.02% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND contrasts with ABT (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -14.36%) BELOW TREND and SYK BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 5/17 positive — defensive names not leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND strength (INTC, QCOM, GOOGL, CAT, LLY) and reduce exposure to names in CORRECTION/BELOW TREND (MSFT, NVDA, META, SHOP, CHTR). Style: Mixed — rotation between Growth and Cyclicals; stay selective given major-tech divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through; LLY (1W: +13.02% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND on drug/earnings momentum. BEARISH: META (1W: -10.41% | 1M: +4.97%) CORRECTION and SHOP (1W: -10.81% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND for continued pressure.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology — monitor breadth within tech (15/24 positive) and whether megacap selling abates. BEARISH: Healthcare — sector breadth low (5/17 positive) and several cyclical/defensive names under pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
INTC near short-term breakout continuation level (watch for consolidation above current 1W gains), NVDA resistance zone as 1W weakness tests buyers (CORRECTION), AAPL support holding in ABOVE TREND (AAPL (1W: +4.24% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND) is a tech-health check.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ABT (+75): FDA clearance headline; ABT (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -14.36%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price is diverging (distribution signal). DD (+80): Q1 beat and guidance lift; monitor materials exposure (DD not in top list but sector showing incremental strength). SLB (+75): Automation/upgrades; energy names like MPC (1W: +10.90% | 1M: +6.85%) ABOVE TREND confirm sector-level bullishness.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-50): EU probe headline; META (1W: -10.41% | 1M: +4.97%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirms price weakness. SHOP (-65): Q1 loss/caution; SHOP (1W: -10.81% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned. CHTR (-50): customer losses; CHTR (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -27.64%) BELOW TREND — confirming downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership as tech strength coexists with cyclical pockets and large-cap divergence; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. INTC (1W: +28.72% | 1M: +114.24%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +28.59%) ABOVE TREND and CAT (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +25.02%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-tech short-term corrections (MSFT CORRECTION, NVDA CORRECTION, META CORRECTION) and bullish news on ABT (+75) while price remains BELOW TREND — watch for confirmation before adding exposure.
